info.title: PowerPointCompareForGit
info.description: Render PowerPoint decks from git history to PNG and compare versions in your diff tool.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Render PowerPoint decks from git history to PNG and compare them.

AI agents: see https://github.com/LearnWithLlew/PowerPointCompareForGit/blob/main/skills/powerpoint-compare/SKILL.md

options.name: --commit
options.description: Comma-separated commits to render, e.g. sha1,sha2,sha3.

options.name: --compare
options.description: Compare two versions in the diff tool. No sha: working copy vs last change. One sha: working copy vs it.
